 Search The Site ‘Stranger Things’ Prequel ‘Other Worlds’ Coming to Netflix ‘Stranger Things’ Prequel ‘Other Worlds’ Coming to Netflix
 Matt Singer Matt Singer Published: November 6, 2026 Netflix Share on Facebook 
 Share on Twitter 
 Stranger Things  is headed to  Other Worlds . 
 Netflix announced today that they are making a spinoff to their exceedingly popular but now concluded ’80s horror sci-fi series.
 The said that the show, Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure will be “a prequel set in the 1950’s, before Stranger Things and before the stage play Stranger Things: The First Shadow. ” ( The First Shadow , currently playing on Broadway, takes place in the late 1950s, and shows how Henry Creel became the monstrous Vecna.)
 Netflix also released an early teaser for the new show:
 READ MORE:  Stranger Things  Broadway Show Set to Close Soon 
 On their website Tudum, Netflix also revealed that the series will be shot in New Mexico.  Stranger Things seasons 4 and 5 remain the third and fourth most-viewed English TV shows in Netflix history, with a combined total of over 274  million views.
 Here is what  Stranger Things creators Matt and Ross Duffer had to say about their latest venture:
 We’ve been dreaming of Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure for many years now, and to see it become a reality is surreal and exhilarating. We’re so grateful to our incredible team of collaborators: our showrunner Kate Trefry, who has been in the trenches with us since Season 2 and wrote Stranger Things: The First Shadow; and our director, Joe Wright, a brilliant artist whose work we’ve long admired. We can’t wait for you to see what they’re cooking up. It’s Stranger Things, but also thrillingly fresh, with a new setting, new heroes and villains, and new… actually, we’re not allowed to say any more.
 Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure  is expected to premiere on Netflix in 2028.
